items.t: Is Texas Instruments (TXN) Trading At A Premium To Cash Flow?
items.sum: Texas Instruments has seen its share price climb sharply over the past few years, which naturally puts the focus on whether the current valuation is well supported by the cash the business can generate. With fresh broker calls and sector headlines swirling around the semiconductor space, the central question for Texas Instruments is how much of that excitement is actually backed by its cash flows.
